title: Holiday Park Four Season RV & Condo Resort

services.name: RV site
services.desc: Due to the unique layout of the 62 acre Resort, WI-FI may not be available directly at the sites. Please enjoy one of our 4 locations with free hotspots Vacation in your own RV site, park model or condo, with access to onsite resort amenities & facilities

services.name: Condo rental
services.desc: Enjoy your own vacation RV site or condo. Enjoy all the activities, amenities and facilities the Resort offers. Explore the beautiful Okanagan Valley surrounding the Resort, including nearby Kelowna and Vernon with their variety of shopping, entertainment, sports facilities, beaches and lakes. Visit the Member Benefits page for more information on the advantages of becoming a Member at Holiday Park Resort. Call for information or an appointment, or drop in to our on-site Sales Centre and meet Marion Lahey, licensed Coldwell Banker REALTOR®, for all your real estate needs in Holiday Park Resort or anywhere in the Okanagan Valley. Please note that RV units coming into the resort are required

services.name: Great place for glamping
services.desc: Awesome place. Beautiful gardens well maintained. Nice pools, three in summer. One for length swimming adults only. 5 star restaurant a little pricey but good. Small cafe good basic cooking at a reasonable price. Several wineries close by, close to lots more. On the edge of Kelowna closer to Winfield but quick access
